0022600141.text: The Utah Jazz (1-3, 1-2 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, on a one-game winning streak) in the Jazz's fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah 12th in the West and San Antonio 10th. Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise) are out for Utah, while Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 Utah lost the season series 1-2, including a 126-109 loss in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026.
